newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Jakarta index ends down in cautious trading.
newsitem.headline: Jakarta index ends down in cautious trading.

text.p: Foreign-led selling in big-caps and profit-taking in small stocks after false rumours on President Suharto's health pushed the Jakarta index down by the close on Friday, brokers said.
The Jakarta composite index fell 4.19 points, or 0.65 percent, to close at 637.43 points.
Total turn-over was 340 billion rupiah against 309 billion rupiah on Thursday. Decliners led gainers by 132 to 62 with 84 issues unchanged.
